beta13.3.description:
Heya. Technically speaking, this is more of a "Beta" than anything, but considering the whole project is a beta, it's more like a Beta for a Beta type deal.

# Anyways, here's what's up.

### On the Engine Side of things, we got:
* Fixed a small bug with the Warm-Up settings so that it actually stops showing up if you pick "Never"
* Made the strum skins work properly now
* Pixel Note Skins now share the same loading scheme as the regular notes (so that skins don't break if you use anything other then default)
* The `onPlayAnimPre` call now includes the character that called it (function argument values are as follows in order: `curCharacter, AnimName, Force, Reversed, Frame`)
* Adjusted the Modchart System to (hopefully) better actually run modcharts (or worse, I didn't really test it that well)
* Introducing: FunkinMemory! With this bad boy (courtesy of V-Slice, btw), I can only pray the memory issue that's been happening will be, at best, resolved, and at worst, slower to happen than the previous builds were.
* 

### On the APWorld Side of things, we got:
* Updated the APWorld for 6.8.0 (It now gets through pre-gen, as god intended)
* Uses APAPI, a WIP helper for both Players and Devs! Currently, optional, but will speed up generation if you have it.

Yeah, that's it. Light, right? Well, we weren't kidding about working on the rewrite, and so far so good on that. No promises, but I guarantee it won't take nearly as long as Week 8 did LMAO

Anyways, that's it. Go play now.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Z11Coding/Mixtape-Engine-Rework/compare/beta13.2...beta13.3
